mostWorthwhile.text: Building water through oxygen and hydroxyl on a cold grain made the surface chemistry understandable, including why it takes two hydrogen additions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final inspection was less engaging than the chemistry because it revealed only one partner and immediately completed the combination.

surprise.text: Some interstellar water can survive solar-system formation, so water can be older than the Sun and planets.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary; I was initially unsure how the icy grains would contribute to the cloud, but the final explanation connected them to shielding and molecular formation.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the cold cloud becomes a solar system, especially after seeing how its ice formed.
